_comment: Chain registry for the index-settlements skill. `substreams` endpoints are transcribed from https://docs.substreams.dev/reference-material/chain-support/chains-and-endpoints (read 2026-07-26). `rpc` is a public JSON-RPC used ONLY to resolve the current head block so the skill can pick a recent start block; every entry below was probed live with eth_blockNumber on 2026-07-26. Override either with --endpoint / --rpc.

_schema.rpc: public JSON-RPC URL, used for eth_blockNumber only
_schema.blockTimeSec: approximate seconds per block, used to translate --minutes into a block count

unsupported._comment: Named here so the skill can fail with a reason instead of a generic 'unknown chain'.
unsupported.solana: Substreams supports Solana (mainnet.sol.streamingfast.io:443) but it is not EVM: the ERC-20 package used by this skill consumes sf.ethereum.type.v2.Block and cannot run against it. Index SPL tokens with a Solana-native package instead.
unsupported.hedera: No Substreams endpoint is published for Hedera. Use the Hedera Mirror Node API.
